candidates.name: cjk_bigram_confusion_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Replacing the ASCII-only tokenizer ([A-Za-z0-9]+) with CJK character bigrams gives non-degenerate similarity scores over Chinese legal text, restoring the confusion disambiguation retrieval mechanism so it surfaces genuinely relevant examples instead of random ones.

candidates.name: label_glossary_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Accumulating canonical ground-truth label strings during training and injecting them as a reference glossary section in the prompt anchors the LLM to exact label forms, reducing surface-form near-miss and specificity errors that account for a large share of the base system's wrong predictions.
